Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking an Aerostructures Design Engineer II to support the development of structural components for our next-generation autonomous aircraft. As a key contributor on the Mechanical Engineering team, you will design and develop high-performance structural components from concept through production release.

You’ll work cross-functionally to ensure structural integrity, manufacturability, and system integration across one of the most advanced autonomous aircraft platforms being built today. This role is ideal for an aerospace mechanical engineer who thrives in hands-on design environments and is eager to take increasing ownership of flight-critical designs.

lists.content:
• Design and develop structural components and assemblies for Shield AI’s next-generation UAV platform, supporting both primary and secondary aircraft structures.
  • Execute all stages of the design lifecycle including conceptual development, initial CAD modeling, detailed design, and drawing release.
  • Perform hand calculations for stress or strain with limited basic FEA analysis, with guidance from senior engineers as needed.
  • Collaborate closely with aerodynamics, propulsion, avionics, payload, and manufacturing teams to support system integration across airframe interfaces.
  • Support structural validation efforts including coupon testing, subcomponent testing, and system-level verification.
  • Generate high-quality design documentation, drawings, interface definitions, and analysis reports in compliance with aerospace standards.
  • Partner with manufacturing and flight test teams to resolve build issues and support hardware through test and deployment.
  • Participate in design reviews and technical discussions, presenting work clearly and incorporating feedback effectively.
  • Continuously improve personal technical depth in structural layout, joints, fasteners, tolerancing, and structural optimization.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 2+ years of experience in aircraft structural design or closely related aerospace structures.
  • Experience designing and releasing structural components in development or production environments.
  • Working knowledge of composite and metallic structures, including fasteners, bonded joints, and load paths.
  • Proficiency in CAD tools (NX, CATIA, SolidWorks, or similar).
  • Understanding of GD&T, tolerance stackups, and DFMA principles.
  • Strong written and verbal technical communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in fast-paced, high-ownership engineering environments
  • Ability to get a S//SAR level security clearance desired

• M.S. degree in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering.
  • Experience supporting UAV, DoD, or aerospace vehicle programs.
  • Familiarity with aerospace standards (MIL-STD, ASME Y14.5, FAA).
  • Experience supporting hardware through test, failure analysis, and design iteration.
  • Exposure to composite design and manufacturing methods.
  • Experience using FEA tools (ANSYS, Abaqus, NASTRAN, or similar) for linear structural analysis

Job Description:
Shield AI is seeking a Fleet Analyst to serve as the data backbone of the Fleet Strategy & Portfolio Management function within Aircraft Division.
Fleet Strategy & Portfolio Management is responsible for translating fleet visibility into business-grounded recommendations on how to align aircraft across customers, programs, captures, and internal demand. The function maintains the authoritative, real-time ledger of every aircraft in the enterprise fleet and turns that visibility into the dashboards, forecasts, and configuration intelligence that drive enterprise decision-making.
The Fleet Analyst will maintain the enterprise fleet ledger, build and own the analytical infrastructure that supports fleet decisions, and translate operational data into clear recommendations for the Senior Manager and Mission Control leadership. This role requires deep understanding of aircraft operations, configuration management, and rigorous data discipline. Decisions made across Fleet Strategy & Portfolio Management depend on the accuracy and timeliness of the data this role produces.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Fleet Analyst to serve as the data backbone of the Fleet Strategy & Portfolio Management function within Aircraft Division.

Fleet Strategy & Portfolio Management is responsible for translating fleet visibility into business-grounded recommendations on how to align aircraft across customers, programs, captures, and internal demand. The function maintains the authoritative, real-time ledger of every aircraft in the enterprise fleet and turns that visibility into the dashboards, forecasts, and configuration intelligence that drive enterprise decision-making.

The Fleet Analyst will maintain the enterprise fleet ledger, build and own the analytical infrastructure that supports fleet decisions, and translate operational data into clear recommendations for the Senior Manager and Mission Control leadership. This role requires deep understanding of aircraft operations, configuration management, and rigorous data discipline. Decisions made across Fleet Strategy & Portfolio Management depend on the accuracy and timeliness of the data this role produces.

lists.content:
Fleet Ledger & Configuration Intelligence
  • Maintain authoritative, real-time visibility of every aircraft in the enterprise fleet, including location, configuration, flight hours, maintenance posture, modification status, and remaining useful life.
  • Track configuration history and downstream impacts as aircraft cycle through customer deployments, test campaigns, training events, and depot-level maintenance.
  • Coordinate with Engineering, Manufacturing, and Sustainment to ensure the ledger reflects ground truth at all times.
    • Analytics Infrastructure & Reporting
  • Build and maintain the analytical infrastructure that makes fleet decisions repeatable and defensible: utilization dashboards, configuration intelligence tooling, lifecycle forecasting, and routine fleet posture reporting.
  • Generate rolling 6, 12, and 24-month forecasts of fleet availability and configuration posture to support contractual commitments, capture activities, and capacity planning.
  • Continuously improve data quality and tooling so the function scales as the fleet grows.
    • Decision Support
  • Translate fleet visibility into clear, decision-ready briefings for the Senior Manager and Mission Control leadership.
  • Surface portfolio-level patterns (underutilized assets, configuration trends, deal-impacting risks) that warrant strategic attention.
  • Provide rapid analytical support for ad hoc fleet questions from senior leadership, Business Development, Program Management, and Finance.

• Bachelor's degree in Operations Research, Engineering, Aviation Management, Data Analytics, or related field.
  • 5+ years of combined military and/or industry experience in aviation logistics, fleet analytics, operations research, or enterprise asset management.
  • Strong proficiency in data tools (Tableau, Power BI, SQL, Excel) with demonstrated ability to build and maintain dashboards used by senior leadership.
  • Working knowledge of aircraft operations, configuration management, or fleet portfolio principles.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate operational data into clear narratives for non-analyst audiences.
  • Excellent attention to detail and discipline in maintaining data quality.

• Prior military aviation maintenance, scheduling, or operations officer experience.
  • Familiarity with formal military planning processes (MDMP, JOPP, or equivalent).
  • Experience with lifecycle modeling, RUL forecasting, or configuration management in aerospace or defense contexts.
  • Exposure to government contract structures (FFP, CPFF, OTA) and how they shape fleet allocation.
  • Experience supporting capture activities, capacity modeling, or proposal feasibility analysis.
  • Familiarity with unmanned aircraft systems, particularly V-BAT or similar platforms.

Fleet Strategy & Portfolio Management is responsible for translating fleet visibility into business-grounded recommendations on how to align aircraft across customers, programs, captures, and internal demand. The function maintains the authoritative, real-time ledger of every aircraft in the enterprise fleet and turns that visibility into the dashboards, forecasts, and configuration intelligence that drive enterprise decision-making.

The Fleet Analyst will maintain the enterprise fleet ledger, build and own the analytical infrastructure that supports fleet decisions, and translate operational data into clear recommendations for the Senior Manager and Mission Control leadership. This role requires deep understanding of aircraft operations, configuration management, and rigorous data discipline. Decisions made across Fleet Strategy & Portfolio Management depend on the accuracy and timeliness of the data this role produces.

descriptionPlain:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube. 


Our Applications Engineers are highly technical, customer-facing problem solvers who play a critical role in deploying Shield AI’s Hivemind software in real-world environments. This role is travel-intensive, with frequent trips, often international, and sometimes lasting multiple weeks, to work directly alongside customers on-site.
This is primarily a Senior-level role, and we’re typically looking for candidates with several years of relevant industry experience. That said, we will consider exceptional mid-level engineers who demonstrate strong technical fundamentals, a hands-on mindset, and a track record of taking initiative in dynamic, customer-driven environments
In this role, you will work closely with customers to understand their requirements, provide technical expertise during deployment, and ensure successful integration of our AI and autonomy products. You’ll also collaborate internally with engineering teams, with opportunities to grow into technical leadership over time.
You Should Apply If:
You’re excited about a travel-heavy role and enjoy being on-site with customers, including international and multi-week engagements
You’re a strong technical contributor (or early in your career and eager to grow) who takes initiative and figures things out
You enjoy problem solving, building relationships, and working at the intersection of engineering and real-world deployment
You’re passionate about autonomy, robotics, or aerospace
You Should Not Apply If:
You prefer minimal travel or want to work primarily from a single location
You want to do 100% R&D and don’t enjoy customer interactions
You’ve never programmed in C, C++, or Rust

Job Description:
Shield AI is seeking an Autonomy Applications Engineer, Learning & Development to help accelerate customer adoption of Hivemind through world-class technical training and enablement. This is a highly technical, customer-facing role for someone who is equally comfortable mastering complex autonomy software, building cutting-edge training content, and leading in-person training engagements with customer engineers and technical stakeholders. 
In this role, you will become a deep expert in the Hivemind software stack and serve as a trusted resource for customers learning to build autonomy with Hivemind. You will develop and maintain training materials, deliver instructor-led training, and help translate product complexity into clear, effective, mission-relevant learning experiences. 
You will also work closely with internal engineering, product, and go-to-market teams to ensure training content stays aligned with the latest product capabilities and field feedback. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys teaching, building, and solving technical problems at the intersection of software, autonomy, and customer success. 
This role includes approximately 30% travel for customer site visits specifically to facilitate in-person training engagements.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking an Autonomy Applications Engineer, Learning & Development to help accelerate customer adoption of Hivemind through world-class technical training and enablement. This is a highly technical, customer-facing role for someone who is equally comfortable mastering complex autonomy software, building cutting-edge training content, and leading in-person training engagements with customer engineers and technical stakeholders. 

In this role, you will become a deep expert in the Hivemind software stack and serve as a trusted resource for customers learning to build autonomy with Hivemind. You will develop and maintain training materials, deliver instructor-led training, and help translate product complexity into clear, effective, mission-relevant learning experiences. 

You will also work closely with internal engineering, product, and go-to-market teams to ensure training content stays aligned with the latest product capabilities and field feedback. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys teaching, building, and solving technical problems at the intersection of software, autonomy, and customer success. 

This role includes approximately 30% travel for customer site visits specifically to facilitate in-person training engagements.

lists.content:
• Become an expert user of the Hivemind software stack and workflows
  • Lead in-person and hands-on customer training engagements for Hivemind software
  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve high-quality technical training materials, guides, labs, and instructor-led content
  • Train customer engineers and technical teams to effectively use Hivemind software and build autonomy applications
  • Help customers troubleshoot software usage issues and support debugging of in training contexts
  • Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to incorporate customer feedback into training content and product improvements
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation and learning resources that help scale customer adoption
  • Help define best practices for autonomy training and customer enablement across Shield AI deployments
  • Represent Shield AI as a technical educator and product expert, helping drive the global proliferation of autonomous systems

• You enjoy teaching highly technical material and can turn complex software concepts into clear, engaging learning experiences
  • You are energized by customer-facing work and enjoy facilitating in-person training engagements
  • You have strong engineering fundamentals and can build credibility quickly with technical users
  • You are comfortable operating with autonomy and ownership in dynamic customer environments
  • You enjoy working across engineering, product, and customer teams to improve both user outcomes and product adoption
  • You are passionate about or have great interest in autonomy, robotics, or defense technology

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
  • 5+ years of relevant experience
  • 3+ years of experience in an applications engineering, integration engineering, solutions engineering, technical training, technical enablement, or similarly customer-facing technical role
  • Strong technical background in software engineering
  • Strong proficiency with modern C++
  • Experience with Python in a professional setting 
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Clear interest in being an educator engineer who enjoys instructing technical users and developing their capability
  • Ability to travel approximately 30%, including occasional international travel a

• 3+ years of experience working in a startup environment
  • Experience in the defense, robotics, aerospace, or autonomous systems industry
  • Experience developing technical documentation, training materials, or instructional content for complex technical products
  • Experience designing hands-on technical labs, workshops, or instructor-led training programs 
    • Senior: $130-$195k
    Staff: $160-235k
    Senior Staff: $185-$280k

This role sits at the front line of customer adoption for Hivemind. As an Autonomy Applications Engineer, Learning & Development, you will help customers build confidence in autonomy software, accelerate their ability to build autonomy with Hivemind, and shape how Shield AI trains the next generation of autonomous systems users. You will be both educator and engineer: teaching customers, building the materials that enable them, and helping bring advanced autonomy into real-world use around the globe.

descriptionBody:
Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking an Autonomy Applications Engineer, Learning & Development to help accelerate customer adoption of Hivemind through world-class technical training and enablement. This is a highly technical, customer-facing role for someone who is equally comfortable mastering complex autonomy software, building cutting-edge training content, and leading in-person training engagements with customer engineers and technical stakeholders. 

In this role, you will become a deep expert in the Hivemind software stack and serve as a trusted resource for customers learning to build autonomy with Hivemind. You will develop and maintain training materials, deliver instructor-led training, and help translate product complexity into clear, effective, mission-relevant learning experiences. 

You will also work closely with internal engineering, product, and go-to-market teams to ensure training content stays aligned with the latest product capabilities and field feedback. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys teaching, building, and solving technical problems at the intersection of software, autonomy, and customer success. 

This role includes approximately 30% travel for customer site visits specifically to facilitate in-person training engagements.

Job Description:
We are seeking a motivated Associate Manufacturing Engineer to support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of manufacturing processes for next-generation aerospace systems. In this role, you will partner with Design Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Supply Chain to transition products from design into production while supporting prototype builds, new product introduction (NPI), and production ramp-up. 
This position may support one or more aircraft systems, including airframe structures, electrical systems, propulsion, mechanical systems, avionics, final integration, or ground support equipment. The ideal candidate is a hands-on problem solver who enjoys working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and contributing to the production of advanced aerospace products.

Job Description:

We are seeking a motivated Associate Manufacturing Engineer to support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of manufacturing processes for next-generation aerospace systems. In this role, you will partner with Design Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Supply Chain to transition products from design into production while supporting prototype builds, new product introduction (NPI), and production ramp-up. 

This position may support one or more aircraft systems, including airframe structures, electrical systems, propulsion, mechanical systems, avionics, final integration, or ground support equipment. The ideal candidate is a hands-on problem solver who enjoys working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and contributing to the production of advanced aerospace products.

lists.content:
• Develop, implement, and optimize manufacturing processes for assigned products or aircraft systems.  

  • Design and improve assembly tools, fixtures, jigs, and manufacturing aids to support safe, repeatable, and efficient production.  

  • Create and maintain work instructions, manufacturing process documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and process flows.  

  • Partner with Design Engineering to improve manufacturability, assembly efficiency, quality, and cost through Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFM/DFA).  

  • Support prototype builds, engineering builds, production readiness activities, and new product introductions.  

  • Troubleshoot manufacturing issues using root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).  

  • Collaborate with Production, Quality, Supply Chain, and Industrial Engineering to improve safety, quality, throughput, and productivity.  

  • Support tooling validation, first article inspections, process qualification, and production validation activities.  

  • Utilize CAD software to develop tooling concepts, manufacturing layouts, and production support equipment.  

  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on reducing waste, improving quality, and increasing manufacturing efficiency.  

  • Ensure manufacturing processes comply with engineering requirements, quality standards, and company procedures.

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.  

  • 0–3 years of experience in manufacturing engineering, production engineering, process engineering, or a related field (internship and co-op experience considered).  

  • Understanding of manufacturing processes, assembly methods, and production operations.  

  • Familiarity with CAD software such as CATIA, Siemens NX, SolidWorks, Creo, or equivalent.  

  • Basic understanding of engineering drawings, GD&T, and manufacturing documentation.  

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.  

  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative manufacturing environment.  

  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.

• Internship or professional experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, robotics, or advanced manufacturing.  

  • Experience supporting prototype builds, NPI, or production environments.  

  • Familiarity with machining, composites, electrical assemblies, mechanical assemblies, or final system integration.  

  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies.  

  • Experience with ERP, MES, or PLM systems.  

  • Familiarity with AS9100 or other regulated manufacturing environments.
